segments.text: Here is an easy way to explain climate change to people.
Get them in a room at 22 degrees, they'll feel comfortable, but then you turn up the AC by 2 degrees and they'll feel hot.
Then you do the opposite, you turn the AC down by 2 degrees and they'll feel pretty cold.
You will have made them feel how much they can perceive in only 2 degree change in temperature.
But in tomorrow's video, I will help you remind them that climate change is about so much more than temperature.
